activity_context.topic_title: Calculating the Position Function of a Particle Using Integration

feedback.worked_solution:
We start by integrating the velocity to get $x(t):$

$$
\begin{aligned}x(t) & =\int v(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\int -7\,\text{d}t \\  & =-7t+C\end{aligned}
$$

To determine $C$, we use the fact that $x(4)=30.$ Substituting this into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}30 & =-7(4)+C \\ 30 & =-28+C \\ C & =58.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the position $x$ of the particle at time $t$ is 

$$
x(t)=-7t+58.
$$
